item.title: Re: Cross-testing
item.content:encoded:
Because 682 and 795 might merge and become a horrible Keter-class monster than the Foundation CAN'T contain, thank you very much.

That Cave Johnson quote fits the Lolfoundation era perfectly… but the site has since grown beyond that. Cross-testing is frowned upon because it's simply too dangerous in-universe, and out of universe, it's very hard to pull off without looking silly or making it seem like you are leeching upvotes from the crosslinked article.

item.title: Cross-testing
item.content:encoded:
They already tried with someone that had a history of anger problems… My guess is that they wanted to try it with something else…

To quote Cave Johnson… Science isn't about WHY. It's about WHY NOT. Why is so much of our science dangerous? Why not marry safe science if you love it so much. In fact, why not invent a special safety door that won't hit you on the butt on the way out, because you are fired.

Why NOT do cross-testing between -682 and -759?

item.title: This must be said:
item.content:encoded:
do not even get me started on this…

Seriously though, good work. The concept is interesting and the execution is just great… One of the best experiment logs I have seen lately!

One nitpick I've had was the use of the word "self-termination" in the last paragraph, as it feels like a case of excessive terminitis (not to mention the fact I personally have always found this exact word rather awkward). Changed to "suicide", feel free to change it back if you really think it should be the former.
